content.text: {"Id":"BUG-TRIAGE-132","Title":"create_todos_from_plan returns opaque EF save error","Section":"Backlog","Priority":"high","Done":false,"Estimate":null,"Note":null,"Description":["create_todos_from_plan correctly validates placeholder dependency IDs, then creates legacy TODO rows via EfTodoService.CreateAsync (EXEC-TODO-###) and only afterward updates todo-execution-state. CreateAsync does not catch DbUpdateException, and MCP tool error serialization returns only exception.Message, so agents see the generic EF outer text \u0027An error occurred while saving the entity changes. See the inner exception for details.\u0027 without constraint/FK detail. Contributing risk on this path: soft-deleted TodoItem rows remain on composite PK (WorkspaceId, Id) while CreateAsync existence checks and GenerateNextTodoIdAsync use filtered queries, so recycled EXEC-TODO ids can fail at SaveChanges as UNIQUE violations; multi-TODO creates also commit one-by-one before execution state is saved, so atomicity depends on compensation that soft-deletes rather than hard-removing rows.","Triage group: triage-group-6c1d2e6df639d55a","Reports: 1"],"TechnicalDetails":["Acceptance criteria:","- After create_iteration_phase succeeds, create_todos_from_plan with multiple valid PlanTodoInput items (empty dependsOnTodoIds) either returns CreateTodosFromPlanResult with the expected EXEC-TODO ids or a structured error payload that includes the root storage cause (for example UNIQUE/FK detail and the failing todo id), never only the bare EF outer DbUpdateException message.","- On batch failure, no net new legacy TODO rows or execution-state phase membership remain for the failed call (retry of the same plan is clean).","- ID allocation and CreateAsync conflict checks account for soft-deleted TodoItem rows (IgnoreQueryFilters or revive), so previously compensated EXEC-TODO-### ids cannot cause an opaque PK uniqueness failure on retry.","- Invalid dependency IDs continue to fail fast with validation errors before any legacy row is committed.","Implementation notes:","- Primary path: TodoExecutionService.CreateTodosFromPlanAsync -\u003E ITodoService.CreateAsync (EfTodoService) -\u003E SaveChangesAsync; tool surface FwhMcpTools.Todo.CreateTodosFromPlan uses McpToolErrors.Serialize which currently emits { error: exception.Message } for non-connectivity failures.","- Map DbUpdateException (and InnerException/SqliteException) inside EfTodoService.CreateAsync (or the execution service) into TodoMutationResult / InvalidOperationException with actionable text; optionally include innermost message in McpToolErrors for storage failures that are not backend_unavailable.","- In CreateAsync and GenerateNextTodoIdAsync, probe TodoItems with IgnoreQueryFilters for soft-deleted collisions; either revive the soft-deleted row or advance NextTodoNumber past occupied ids.","- Prefer a single transactional unit for the multi-TODO legacy creates plus execution-state write, or ensure compensation hard-clears or revives ids so retries are deterministic; AppendAuditAsync should set WorkspaceId explicitly rather than relying only on StampWorkspaceId."],"ImplementationTasks":null,"CompletedDate":null,"DoneSummary":null,"Remaining":null,"PriorityNote":null,"Reference":null,"Phase":null,"DependsOn":null,"FunctionalRequirements":["FR-MCP-TRIAGE-002"],"TechnicalRequirements":["TR-MCP-TRIAGE-004"],"IdempotencyKey":null}
